thread:
incidents_bot: :rotating_light: Pager — Billing anomaly: downstream ledger vs ingest token counts diverging for customers in EU region. Over-age flags firing for ~12 tenants. Investigating. Detected at 2025-05-03T14:06:39Z.

sara_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing logs from the emitter and aggregator. Anyone seen recent deploys?

mike_sre: No deploys in the last hour. Looks like a spike in retry traffic from proxy cluster eu-west-2a. Sharing quick metric: `tokens_emitted` vs `tokens_aggregated` diverge ~+8% over 30m.

linda_billing: 12 tenants showing provisional overage emails queued. Can we pause alerts? Customers already getting notifications.

sara_oncall: Please pause alerting. @linda_billing can you hold outbound overage emails?

linda_billing: Paused outbound overage emails for the queue named `billing-notify-us-east` and `billing-notify-eu`. Confirmed.

jon_prod: Any immediate customer-visible impact besides emails? Are charges being applied?

linda_billing: No finalized invoices yet. Flags would trigger adjustments later; we can stop promotions to finalized state.

mike_sre: Root cause hypothesis: emitter-side duplicate ACK replay causing re-emits; downstream aggregator dedup TTL not extended during a consumer restart. Working snapshot of stream consumer offsets: `consumer_offsets[aggregator]=1239471` vs emitter high-water greater by ~200k.

sara_oncall: Repro steps for mitigation: 1) throttle emitter retry loop 2) bump KV dedup TTL to 12h on aggregator 3) trigger a targeted reingest reconciliation job. I'll run step 1 and 2 now.

alex_support: Noted — prepping a short customer message if we need to escalate. Keep me posted.

mike_sre: Throttle applied: `kubectl scale deployment emitter --replicas=2 --namespace prod-eu` (was 5). Confirming reduced emit rate.

sara_oncall: Dedup TTL bumped: `REDWOOD_DEDUP_TTL=43200` exported and rollout applied to aggregator config. Watching error budget and token gap.

mike_sre: Gap growth slowed within 60s. Aggregator backlog draining.

linda_billing: I'm running a dry-run reconciliation to estimate correction delta before we unpause notifications. ETA ~10m.

incidents_bot: System note: automated rollback candidate detected for emitter autoscaler. Marking as monitor-only for now.

sara_oncall: Reconciliation dry-run shows net correction vs provisional flags: ~-75% of flagged tokens reconcile (i.e., will remove flags). Good.

linda_billing: Great — will keep alerts paused. I'll prepare a follow-up to customers: short note that we had transient counter duplication, mitigation in place, no invoices were finalized, we'll follow up with corrected statements.

jon_prod: Moving to handoff: sara, mike — if gap stays stable for 10m and reconciliation finishes, let's close P2 and hand to billing-ops for postmortem.

sara_oncall: Agree. I'll stay on for the next 15m, then hand to @linda_billing for customer comms and postmortem tracking.

alex_support: Ready to send the customer note when you give the go. Template: "We detected temporary overage notifications caused by internal token-count duplication. No charges were finalized. We're correcting counts and will follow up."

mike_sre: Backlog fully drained at +8m after throttle. No further emits seen.

sara_oncall: Closing incident thread: moving to postmortem tracking issue PM-435. Final status: mitigated, no billing finalized, customer emails paused, follow-up comms queued.

linda_billing: Taking ownership for postmortem and customer comms. Thanks team. :heart:
